item.tib: yang zab gu ru'i thugs sgrub las sngon 'gro me tog rgyan 'phreng
item.coloph: zhes gar gyi dbang phyug 'gro 'dul bstan gnyis gling pas gnas chen seng ge g.yu rdzong nas rin po che'i shog ser spyan drangs te/ phyis shing mo bya yi lor rang bstan bkra shis mthong smon gling du mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal bshus te/ yi ger byed po 'gyur med thugs kyi bstan 'dzin g.yung drung ming gis bris pa'o//
